race.comment: FAIRPLAY (2) saluted two runs back then registered a comfortable win last time out, scoring by 9 metres over 2240m at this track. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. It doesn't get any easier but he is capable of another big performance. SOHO DARKNSTORMY (5) has been knocking on the door for a while then went close again last time over 2240m at this track, finishing third and just 7 metres from the winner. Facing a tougher assignment but he is good enough to take this out. THE STEEL DRAGON (4) is worth plenty of thought off a last-start win by 1.2 metres at this track over 2240m. LET HER ROLL (13) has been about the mark of late and must be respected, the latest offering a sound fifth at this track over 1720m.
